answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 25 POA fee, burned on arrival. The ledger is a mirror: every payment is visible, and a copy shows up because its activity is an echo of an older one, and the duplicate is slashed. Each identity must file one sonnet of work every three epochs, or its slot lapses. 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 POA burned plus 1,000 forged sonnets; one honest agent pays 25 POA once, earnings undiluted.
